# datadog_feature_flag_allocations (Resource)

Manages the complete ordered allocation list for one feature flag in one environment. Every write uses the API's replace-all operation. Progressive rollout start, pause, resume, and stop actions are intentionally not managed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datadog_feature_flag" "checkout" {
  key                 = "checkout-redesign"
  name                = "Checkout redesign"
  value_type          = "BOOLEAN"
  default_variant_key = "off"
  variants = [
    { key = "off", name = "Off", value = "false" },
    { key = "on", name = "On", value = "true" },
  ]
}

resource "datadog_feature_flag_environment" "production" {
  name    = "Production"
  queries = ["env:production"]
}

resource "datadog_feature_flag_environment_config" "checkout_production" {
  feature_flag_id = datadog_feature_flag.checkout.id
  environment_id  = datadog_feature_flag_environment.production.id
  enabled         = true
}

resource "datadog_feature_flag_allocations" "checkout_production" {
  feature_flag_id = datadog_feature_flag.checkout.id
  environment_id  = datadog_feature_flag_environment.production.id
  depends_on      = [datadog_feature_flag_environment_config.checkout_production]

  allocations = [
    {
      key  = "checkout-redesign-staff-production"
      name = "Checkout redesign for staff"
      type = "FEATURE_GATE"

      targeting_rules = [
        {
          conditions = [
            {
              attribute = "user.tier"
              operator  = "EQUALS"
              value     = ["staff"]
            },
          ]
        },
      ]

      variant_weights = [
        {
          variant_key = "on"
          value       = 100
        },
      ]
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `allocations` (Attributes List) Ordered allocations. The first matching targeting rule determines the variant distribution. Allocation keys are unique across the Datadog organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocations))
- `environment_id` (String) UUID of the feature flag environment.
- `feature_flag_id` (String) UUID of the feature flag.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--allocations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocations`

Required:

- `key` (String) Stable allocation key. Keys must be unique across the organization, not only within this flag and environment.
- `name` (String) Human-readable allocation name.
- `targeting_rules` (Attributes List) Alternative targeting rules. Rules are ORed; conditions within one rule are ANDed. Use an empty list for an allocation that matches all traffic. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocations--targeting_rules))
- `variant_weights` (Attributes List) Variant distribution served when the allocation matches. Percentage weights should sum to 100. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocations--variant_weights))

Optional:

- `experiment_id` (String) Optional experiment UUID associated with this allocation.
- `exposure_schedule` (Attributes) Declarative progressive rollout schedule. Runtime start, pause, resume, and stop actions are not managed by this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocations--exposure_schedule))
- `guardrail_metrics` (Attributes List) Metrics that pause or abort a progressive rollout when they trigger. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocations--guardrail_metrics))
- `type` (String) Allocation type: FEATURE_GATE or CANARY. Valid values are `FEATURE_GATE`, `CANARY`. Defaults to `"FEATURE_GATE"`.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Server-assigned allocation UUID.
- `order_position` (Number) Server-assigned evaluation position.

<a id="nestedatt--allocations--targeting_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocations.targeting_rules`

Required:

- `conditions` (Attributes List) Conditions that must all match for this targeting rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocations--targeting_rules--conditions))

<a id="nestedatt--allocations--targeting_rules--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocations.targeting_rules.conditions`

Required:

- `attribute` (String) Evaluation-context attribute to compare.
- `operator` (String) Comparison operator: EQUALS, ONE_OF, NOT_ONE_OF, MATCHES, NOT_MATCHES, LT, LTE, GT, GTE, or IS_NULL. Valid values are `EQUALS`, `ONE_OF`, `NOT_ONE_OF`, `MATCHES`, `NOT_MATCHES`, `LT`, `LTE`, `GT`, `GTE`, `IS_NULL`.
- `value` (List of String) String values used by the operator.



<a id="nestedatt--allocations--variant_weights"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocations.variant_weights`

Required:

- `value` (Number) Percentage weight from 0 through 100. Value must be between 0.000000 and 100.000000.
- `variant_key` (String) Key of a variant declared on the parent feature flag.


<a id="nestedatt--allocations--exposure_schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocations.exposure_schedule`

Required:

- `rollout_options` (Attributes) Rollout cadence and automatic-start settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocations--exposure_schedule--rollout_options))
- `rollout_steps` (Attributes List) Ordered exposure steps. Exposure ratios range from 0 through 1. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocations--exposure_schedule--rollout_steps))

Optional:

- `absolute_start_time` (String) RFC3339 timestamp at which the rollout starts.
- `control_variant_key` (String) Key of the control variant used for rollout analysis.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Server-assigned exposure schedule UUID.

<a id="nestedatt--allocations--exposure_schedule--rollout_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocations.exposure_schedule.rollout_options`

Required:

- `strategy` (String) Rollout strategy: UNIFORM_INTERVALS or NO_ROLLOUT. Valid values are `UNIFORM_INTERVALS`, `NO_ROLLOUT`.

Optional:

- `autostart` (Boolean) Whether Datadog starts the rollout automatically.
- `selection_interval_ms` (Number) Interval between rollout steps in milliseconds. Value must be at least 0.


<a id="nestedatt--allocations--exposure_schedule--rollout_steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocations.exposure_schedule.rollout_steps`

Required:

- `exposure_ratio` (Number) Fraction of matching traffic exposed, from 0 through 1. Value must be between 0.000000 and 1.000000.

Optional:

- `grouped_step_index` (Number) Index grouping steps evaluated together. Defaults to the step's list index. Value must be at least 0.
- `interval_ms` (Number) Optional interval before this step in milliseconds. Value must be at least 0.
- `is_pause_record` (Boolean) Whether this entry represents a pause record. Defaults to `false`.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Server-assigned rollout step UUID.
- `order_position` (Number) Server-assigned step position.



<a id="nestedatt--allocations--guardrail_metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocations.guardrail_metrics`

Required:

- `metric_id` (String) Datadog metric monitor identifier used as a guardrail.
- `trigger_action` (String) Action when the metric triggers: PAUSE or ABORT. Valid values are `PAUSE`, `ABORT`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import datadog_feature_flag_allocations.checkout_production "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111:22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
```
